other_distinctive_markers: The image captures the caudal peduncle and the upper lobe of the caudal fin. Visible features include high-luminance circular blobs on the peduncle arranged in loosely vertical columns, and a prominent longitudinal ridge along the peduncle characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient. These features are situated in the posterior anatomical region, which is outside the lateral flank and dorsal fin zones specified in the primary ontology.
